title: Drop and Extraction
author: Marguerite Iversen
blurb: Wren Thackeray, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
